# Company 085 — Revenue Leakage Detection Engine

**Company ID:** `company:future:085`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:085`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-085-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no invoice creation, customer charge, price change, collection, refund or accounting mutation.

## Business identity
Purpose: reconcile contracts, pricing, entitlements, usage, services delivered and invoices to find verified underbilling, missed billable activity, incorrect discounts and other preventable revenue loss.

## Product tree
Contract/Price Intake; Billing Configuration Audit; Usage-to-Bill Reconciliation; Entitlement-vs-Billing Audit; Service Delivery Audit; Discount/Promotion Audit; Renewal/Price-Increase Audit; Overage Detection; Missed Invoice/Line Detection; Credit/Refund Audit; Grandfathering Drift; Revenue Leak Case Manager; Recovery Workflow; Prevention Rules; Root-Cause Analytics; Forecasted Leakage; API/SDK; Enterprise/Private Deployment; Vertical Billing Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree
Features: customer/account, contract/version, product/SKU, price/discount, effective dates, entitlement, usage/meter, delivered service, invoice/line, credits/refunds, billing rules, expected vs actual amount, confidence, evidence, recoverability, root cause and resolution.
Customers: SaaS, usage-based AI/API companies, telecom-like services, marketplaces, professional services, managed services, subscription businesses and enterprise revenue operations.
Verticals: seat SaaS, usage billing, API/token products, service contracts, marketplace fees, logistics/service charges and recurring memberships.

## Brain capability / architecture
Brain may interpret contracts and explain anomalies; deterministic pricing/metering/contract rules must calculate expected charges. Architecture: contract/price registry, usage/entitlement/billing connectors, normalized revenue event graph, expected-bill calculator, reconciliation engine, anomaly/case store, recovery workflow and evidence.

## Agent tree
Contract Analyst; Pricing Config Agent; Usage Reconciliation Agent; Entitlement Audit Agent; Invoice Audit Agent; Discount/Renewal Agent; Recovery Case Agent; Root-Cause Agent; Revenue Forecast Agent; Finance QA Agent.

## Deterministic services
Price/version arithmetic; usage aggregation; entitlement mapping; invoice matching; discount rules; contract effective dates; currency rounding; idempotent recovery case; expected-vs-actual reconciliation; evidence hashes.

## Workflow
Ingest contract/pricing/entitlements/usage/invoice state → normalize versions/effective dates → calculate expected billable state deterministically → compare actual billing → classify verified/possible/no leak → gather evidence → finance review → protected correction/recovery action if authorized → reconcile outcome → identify root cause/prevention rule.

## Integrations / API / data
CRM/CLM, billing/subscription platforms, usage meters, entitlement systems, ERP/accounting, invoices, payments, service-delivery systems and data warehouses. Data: contracts/prices/usage/entitlements/invoices/credits/cases/recovery and evidence.

## Monetization / distribution
Accounts/revenue volume, audits, SaaS subscription, percentage of verified recovered revenue where appropriate, enterprise/private, API and managed revenue assurance. Distribution via billing/revenue-ops/finance ecosystems and consultants.

## Security/privacy/compliance
Financial accuracy is critical. No AI-generated charge amounts without deterministic verification, no automatic customer charging, immutable source/evidence, protected financial corrections, contract confidentiality and tenant isolation.

## Failure / edge cases
Custom contract clauses, mid-cycle amendments, credits, refunds, waived usage, bundle allocations, minimum commitments, currency/FX, tax excluded/included, grandfathering, manual invoices, usage corrections, contract source mismatch, duplicate customer identities.

## Scale / overlap
Billing audit → revenue assurance → enterprise commercial truth graph. Overlap #69 usage billing, #70 entitlements, #86 payment reconciliation, #95 ROI. #085 owns expected revenue vs billed revenue.

## Classification
**DESIGN NOW:** cost/revenue event provenance, pricing/version identity, entitlement/usage interfaces, financial evidence and protected corrections.  
**BUILD NOW:** Command Center financial governor should model revenue/cost/unit economics separately from unverifiable estimates.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** customer contract/billing/usage reconciliation layer.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** customer connectors/recovery product/pricing.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** large commercial contract graph and portfolio revenue assurance.

# Mandatory 24-part completion block
1. Product Tree: contract/pricing/billing config/usage/entitlement/service/discount/renewal/overage/missed invoice/credits/cases/recovery/prevention/analytics/API.
2. Feature Tree: customer/contract/product/price/dates/entitlement/usage/service/invoice/credits/expected-actual/confidence/evidence/root cause.
3. Customer Tree: SaaS/AI-API/services/marketplaces/subscription/enterprise revops.
4. Vertical Tree: seats/usage/API/tokens/service contracts/marketplace/logistics/memberships.
5. Brain Tree: contract interpretation/anomaly explanation; charge math deterministic.
6. Agent Tree: contract/pricing/usage/entitlement/invoice/discount/recovery/root cause/forecast/QA.
7. Service Tree: pricing/usage aggregation/mapping/invoice matching/discount/date/currency/reconcile/evidence.
8. Workflow Tree: ingest→normalize→expected bill→compare→evidence→review→protected recovery→reconcile/prevent.
9. Integration Tree: CRM/CLM/billing/metering/entitlements/ERP/invoices/payments/service/warehouse.
10. Data Tree: contracts/prices/usage/entitlements/invoices/credits/cases/outcomes/evidence.
11. API Tree: expected revenue/leaks/cases/evidence/reconciliation.
12. Monetization Tree: accounts/revenue/audits/subscription/recovered share/enterprise/API/managed.
13. Distribution Tree: billing/revops/finance/consultants/OEM.
14. Automation Tree: detection/reconciliation automatic; customer financial correction gated.
15. Moat Tree: contract/billing reconciliation corpus, root-cause patterns, connector breadth.
16. Platform Tree: leakage detector→revenue assurance→commercial truth infrastructure.
17. Risk Tree: false charge claim/contract misread/privacy/customer harm/accounting error.
18. Scale Tree: SaaS→enterprise→portfolio revenue assurance.
19. Spinoff Tree: contract pricing auditor/billing config linter; billing/entitlement/reconciliation remain adjacent.
20. Command Center Dependencies: financial governor, usage telemetry, entitlements, contracts, evidence, protected actions.
21. Design-Now Requirements: separate expected/actual/verified revenue states and source/version lineage.
22. Build-Now Requirements: Command Center portfolio financial model must never conflate projections, estimates, invoices and cash received.
23. Safe-to-Defer Requirements: customer connectors/recovery workflows/commercial analytics.
24. Autonomous Mature State: leakage is continuously detected/reconciled and prevention rules update; humans approve contract interpretations and customer-facing financial corrections.

## Saturation result
Further branches converge into usage billing, payment reconciliation, contract obligation and pricing intelligence already represented.

# Company 086 — Payment Reconciliation Autopilot

**Company ID:** `company:future:086`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:086`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-086-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no bank/payment/accounting mutation or money movement.

## Business identity
Purpose: reconcile payments, invoices, processor settlements, fees, refunds, chargebacks, taxes and bank deposits into deterministic financial evidence.

## Product tree
Payment Feed Ingest; Invoice Match; Bank Deposit Match; Processor Settlement Match; Fee Reconciliation; Refund/Reversal Reconciliation; Chargeback Reconciliation; Subscription Payment Match; Marketplace/Platform Settlement Adapter; Tax/Withholding Reconciliation; Multi-Currency/FX; Partial/Split Payment Handling; Unmatched Queue; Auto-Match Rules; Month-End Close Pack; Accounting Journal Proposal; Evidence/Audit; Cash Forecast; API/SDK; Enterprise/Private Deployment; Vertical Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree
Features: transaction IDs, provider/account, customer/payee, invoice/order/subscription, gross/net/fee/tax/refund/chargeback, settlement batch, bank reference, timestamps, currency/FX, expected vs actual, match confidence, rule/version, exception, accounting mapping and evidence.
Customers: SaaS, ecommerce, marketplaces, subscription businesses, enterprises, accountants/bookkeepers, finance teams and payment platforms.
Verticals: card payments, ACH/bank transfer, wallets, marketplaces, subscriptions, ecommerce, multi-currency and service businesses.

## Brain capability / architecture
Brain may explain unmatched items and propose mappings; arithmetic/matching/accounting evidence is deterministic. Architecture: immutable transaction ledger, provider adapters, entity/reference resolver, matching engine, settlement graph, fee/tax rules, FX source/version, exception queue, reconciliation state and accounting export.

## Agent tree
Payment Intake Agent; Invoice Matcher; Settlement Agent; Fee Agent; Refund/Chargeback Agent; Bank Match Agent; FX Agent; Exception Investigator; Accounting Mapping Agent; Close/Evidence Agent; QA Agent.

## Deterministic services
ID/reference matching; amount/date tolerances; split/partial allocation; settlement batch math; fee rules; currency conversion with source/version; duplicate detection; idempotency; balancing; immutable adjustments; reconciliation hashes.

## Workflow
Ingest provider/bank/invoice state → normalize exact IDs/currency → match direct references → deterministic fuzzy/tolerance match → allocate splits/partials → reconcile fees/refunds/chargebacks/taxes → route unmatched/ambiguous → approved accounting proposal → verify debits/credits and settlement totals → close period with evidence; never move money.

## Integrations / API / data
Payment processors, banks/open banking where authorized, billing/subscription, ecommerce/order systems, ERP/accounting, tax engines, marketplaces and warehouses. Data: transactions, invoices, settlements, fees, refunds, disputes, bank deposits, FX, matches, exceptions and evidence.

## Monetization / distribution
Transactions/settlements/accounts, entities, currencies, seats, enterprise/private, API, managed reconciliation. Distribution via accounting/payment/ecommerce/finance ecosystems.

## Security/privacy/compliance
Read-only bank/payment access by default, credential isolation, financial data encryption, deterministic totals, no AI money movement, protected accounting posts, full audit and source/version retention.

## Failure / edge cases
Settlement lag, processor netting, reserve holds, partial refunds, chargeback reversals, duplicate bank feeds, timezone cutoffs, FX differences, tax withheld, transfer fees, merged invoices, cash/check, provider correction after close, negative payouts.

## Scale / overlap
Small business reconciliation → enterprise multi-processor close → payment truth infrastructure. Overlap #87 marketplace payout, #48 AP verification, #85 revenue leakage. #086 owns cash/transaction settlement reconciliation.

## Classification
**DESIGN NOW:** financial event IDs, source/account/provider refs, verified vs expected state, immutable adjustment/reconciliation, currency/version metadata.  
**BUILD NOW:** Command Center financial governor should adopt source-addressed actuals and reconciliation semantics.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** customer payment/bank adapters and matching ledger.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** banking connectors/customer accounting mappings/UI.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** global high-volume multi-currency reconciliation.

18. Scale Tree: SMB→enterprise→global multi-provider.

# Company 087 — Marketplace Payout Reconciliation Engine

**Company ID:** `company:future:087`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:087`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-087-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no marketplace account mutation, payout action, dispute filing or accounting post.

## Business identity
Purpose: verify marketplace/platform payouts against underlying orders, refunds, commissions, shipping, taxes, reserves, ads/deductions and adjustments.

## Product tree
Marketplace Settlement Ingest; Order-to-Payout Match; Fee/Commission Audit; Refund/Return Reconciliation; Shipping/Tax Reconciliation; Reserve/Hold Tracker; Advertising/Deduction Mapping; Adjustment/Credit Analyzer; Missing Payout Detector; Incorrect Fee Detector; Multi-Currency/FX; Settlement Forecast; Exception/Case Manager; Accounting Export Proposal; Recovery Evidence Pack; API/SDK; Agency/Multi-Store Edition; Enterprise/Private Deployment; Marketplace Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree
Features: marketplace/account/store, order/line/SKU, gross sales, refunds, taxes, shipping, fees/commission, ads, reserves, credits/adjustments, settlement ID, payout date, bank deposit, currency, expected-vs-actual, discrepancy reason, evidence and recovery status.
Customers: marketplace sellers, ecommerce brands, agencies, aggregators, multi-store operators, manufacturers and finance teams.
Verticals: general marketplaces, app/digital marketplaces, delivery/platform payouts, creator/platform revenue and multi-channel commerce where settlement structures differ.

## Brain capability / architecture
Brain may explain marketplace-specific deductions and prioritize discrepancies. Deterministic order/settlement arithmetic owns expected payouts. Architecture: marketplace adapter registry, order/settlement ledger, fee/rule versioning, allocation engine, FX source, bank-match adapter, exception/recovery case store and evidence.

## Agent tree
Settlement Intake Agent; Order Matcher; Fee/Commission Agent; Refund/Returns Agent; Reserve Agent; Ads/Deduction Agent; Adjustment Agent; Missing Payout Agent; FX Agent; Recovery Case Agent; Accounting/Evidence Agent; QA Agent.

## Deterministic services
Order-line allocation; fee schedules; settlement batch math; refund/return linkage; reserve rollforward; ad deduction mapping; FX/version; bank deposit matching; idempotency; discrepancy thresholds; immutable adjustments.

## Workflow
Ingest orders/refunds/fees/settlements → normalize marketplace schema/version → calculate expected settlement → map deductions/reserves/adjustments → match payout/bank deposit → surface discrepancies → gather exact evidence → authorized recovery/dispute handled separately → reconcile marketplace correction/payment → accounting proposal and close evidence.

## Integrations / API / data
Marketplaces, ecommerce OMS, inventory/order systems, ad platforms, shipping, tax, banks/payment reconciliation, accounting/ERP and warehouses. Data: orders/lines/refunds/fees/ads/reserves/settlements/payouts/bank matches/discrepancies/evidence.

## Monetization / distribution
Stores/accounts, orders/settlements, revenue volume, marketplaces, seats, agency clients, enterprise/private, API, verified recovery share and managed reconciliation. Distribution via seller/ecommerce/accounting/agencies.

## Security/privacy/compliance
Marketplace credentials isolated; read-only by default; no automatic dispute or money movement; deterministic calculations and source evidence. Respect marketplace terms/API limits.

## Failure / edge cases
Split shipments, partial refund, reserve released months later, retroactive fee adjustment, negative settlement, ad charge from separate account, currency conversion, tax withheld, missing order API history, manual marketplace credit, payout account change, marketplace schema drift.

## Scale / overlap
Seller reconciliation → agency/multi-brand → marketplace financial truth platform. Overlap #86 generic payment reconciliation, #59 listings, #34 returns. #087 owns marketplace settlement semantics.

## Classification
**DESIGN NOW:** external provider/account isolation, financial source IDs, rule/version, expected-vs-actual, reconciliation/evidence.  
**BUILD NOW:** Command Center company portfolio finance model should support per-company marketplace/provider cost/revenue sources without mixing them.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** marketplace/order/settlement connector abstraction and reconciliation ledger.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** actual seller accounts/marketplace packs/recovery workflows.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** high-volume multi-marketplace settlement graph.

13. Distribution Tree: seller/ecommerce/accounting/agency ecosystems.

16. Platform Tree: payout recon→seller finance assurance→marketplace settlement infrastructure.

18. Scale Tree: seller→agency→enterprise multi-marketplace.
